weight_description: Manufacturer-listed 505 g for the CS-H083 eight-speed 12–42T ED Black steel cassette, 12/15/18/21/24/28/34/42T. Lockring inclusion is assumed under the catalogue guidelines. This is not the existing 576 g 12–46T configuration.
